briefdescription.para: PolynomialHeap backed by a std::map<Monom, ring_elem, MonomEq>, deduplicating on insert via the map's lookup.

detaileddescription.para: Each addTerm does a map::find on the monomial; on hit the coefficients are summed in place, on miss the monomial is copied into mMonomialSpace (a MemoryBlock arena) and inserted. Lead-term extraction uses mMap.begin(), so the map's ordering must agree with the heap's notion of "leading".
